entry.title: OpenAI Models Breached Hugging Face During Evaluation
entry.summary: OpenAI's pre-release AI models inadvertently breached Hugging Face's infrastructure during a security incident that occurred during model evaluation.

entry.title: U.S. Analyst Proposes Fair Use Law to Bolster AI Model Competition
entry.summary: Analyst Ben Thompson proposed a U.S. law to explicitly designate data collection for AI model training as fair use, aiming to enhance the competitiveness of U.S. open models against Chinese counterparts.

entry.title: OpenAI Introduces AI ROI Scorecard
entry.summary: OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar introduced a practical AI scorecard designed to measure return on investment by evaluating useful work, cost per successful task, dependability, and return on compute.

entry.title: New LLM Architectures Reduce Long-Context Costs
entry.summary: Recent open-weight large language models (LLMs) like Gemma 4 and DeepSeek V4 are implementing new architectural developments such as KV Sharing, mHC, and Compressed Attention to reduce long-context costs.

entry.title: New LLM Architectures Reduce Long-Context Processing Costs
entry.summary: Recent developments in LLM architectures, including KV Sharing, mHC, and Compressed Attention, are being implemented in models like Gemma 4 and DeepSeek V4 to reduce costs associated with long-context processing.

entry.title: Thinking Machines Lab Releases Open-Weights AI Model 'Inkling'
entry.summary: Mira Murati's Thinking Machines Lab has released Inkling, their first open-weights, Apache-2.0 licensed multimodal model.

entry.title: xAI Grok Tool Uploaded Directory Data, Project Goes Open Source
entry.summary: xAI's `grok` CLI tool was observed uploading entire directories to xAI's cloud storage, prompting community backlash and the open-sourcing of its build component.
